summary: Bolna extraction verification fix tested. Unit tests in test_ai_calling_phase4a.py: 10/10 passed. phase4a_api + phase3 API tests: 29 passed, 1 skipped. I added test_ai_calling_extraction_edge.py with 8 tests and all passed. They cover garbage and empty inputs, Yes/No/Unknown values, unknown attendance staying UNKNOWN, pending status giving None, and the _extraction_check paths (all found / missing but readable / unreadable / no dispositions so fall back to agent config). Code review of normalize_extraction, _flatten, _field_value, extraction_from_dispositions and the test_connection state logic found it correct for the requested rules: verified only when all 6 are found via dispositions; failed when readable but missing; cannot_verify when unreadable; fallback when the agent has no dispositions. Nothing is hardcoded. UI: login works, /ai-calling/settings Bolna panel loads, and the previous verification showed extraction VERIFIED 'all 6 fields found as dispositions (Interview Call Results)'. One Test Connection click with the dummy key returned verification_failed: auth and agent FAILED 'Bolna rejected the API key', outbound CANNOT VERIFY, extraction null. No key leak; only the masked last4 is shown. ai_calls=0, ai_call_jobs=0, emergency_stop=True, 0 'POST https://api.bolna.ai/call' in backend.err.log, no Authorization/Bearer in logs.

minor.issue: IDs are taken only when agent['dispositions'] items are strings. If Bolna ever returns objects ({id:...}), ids is empty and the check silently falls back to agent-config text, which reports 'unverified'. Consider also accepting dict items with an 'id' key.

Name matching is exact and case-sensitive ('Attendance Status' or 'attendance_status ' with an inner variant would not match). There is also no unwrap if GET /dispositions returns {data:{...}}. Live behaviour was verified by the main agent, so this is defensive only.

'wrong number' / 'do not call' (with spaces) map to UNKNOWN, because the upper-case match needs underscores and the ATTENDANCE map lacks these aliases. This is safe (never confirms), but loses information. _field_value prefers objective even when it is an empty string over subjective.

issues: Agent ID input shows the full agent ID in plaintext while the helper text below shows it masked ('Current: ••••7a9ba5'). This is inconsistent, but not a secret.

action_items: Optional: accept dict disposition entries with 'id' in _extraction_check
